name: Abadiño (Spain)
description: Square flag of squares each formed of four triangles, white at the hoist, yellow above, green below and red at the fly, with the inscription ABADIÑO 1977 URTEA at the centre.
history: The current flag of Abadiño is based on an earlier one dating from 1896 which disappeared in 1975; it was remade in 1977 from a copy kept in the Galíndez palace. The flag is composed of squares each formed of four coloured triangles, white at the left, yellow above, green below and red at the right.

features.role: pattern of squares each divided per saltire into white, yellow, green and red triangles
